prompt: When should the customer flip the catch?
promptZh: 顧客應在什麼時候翻轉卡扣？

options.text: While rotating the griddle in the air
options.zh: 拿著烤盤在空中轉動時

options.text: When the handle is attached on the left
options.whyZh: 要先拆把手，不能裝著翻。

options.text: After setting down the griddle and removing the handle
options.zh: 放下烤盤並拆掉把手後
options.whyZh: 順序是放下、拆卸、翻卡扣，最後才重新裝。

options.text: Only after reattaching the handle on the other side
options.zh: 等把手裝到另一側後才翻
options.whyZh: 要先翻卡扣，再裝到另一側。

explanationZh: 順序是放下、拆卸、翻卡扣，最後才重新裝。
evidence: Can I flip it while attached? I’d like to move it when I turn the griddle. | Set the griddle down first. Remove the handle, then flip the catch and attach it on the other side.

vocabulary.note: 先把物品安穩放下再操作。
